User: Oh, I guess they could be a little unhealthy sometimes, but to me, I believe you should eat what you want to eat. You know, don't restrict yourself because that's pretty upsetting to restrict yourself in my point of view. If you want to eat some nuggets, I think you should still order six-piece nuggets and if you can't afford both, but really want the nuggets, you should get the nuggets.
Agent: I understand your perspective on enjoying what you eat. When thinking about the nuggets themselves, what physical qualities would make them "bad" for you? For example, if they were soggy, dry, or cold?
